title: The Thirteenth Sigil
unlockHint: Discovered by seeking the brand of the Oracle itself.
revealText: There is no thirteenth month, and yet the Oracle keeps a thirteenth sigil — unassigned, unclaimed, waiting. Old Oracle-keepers say it belongs to no creature because it belongs to whoever finds it. Some say it marks the reader, not the read.
revealSubtext: You have uncovered a secret the twelve courts do not speak of openly. Carry it quietly.

title: The Whisper of Aether
unlockHint: Discovered by speaking the old word into the page.
revealText: Before the Oracle had twelve creatures, it had one word: Aether, the space between all things, the breath a reading takes before it begins. To type it here is to remind the Oracle that you already understand more than you think you do.
revealSubtext: The Whisper of Aether has been added to your discoveries. Few visitors ever think to look for it.
